name: Butler James
description: Long-serving butler of the Hartley household, meticulous and reserved.
alibi: Claims he was polishing silverware in the kitchen all evening.

name: Mrs. Hartley
description: Owner of the mansion and host of the dinner party.
alibi: Says she was greeting guests at the front door.

name: Guest Emily
description: A guest invited to the party, new acquaintance of the Hartleys.
alibi: Claims she was on the balcony for most of the evening.
